requirements.title: Local catalog, cart, sandbox payment, order, return and publishing checks
requirements.evidence: npm run check: 87 unit tests; npm run test:integration: 27 integration tests; desktop/mobile commerce browser flow: 27 screens with zero errors. Tests cover stock races, duplicate payments, roles, returns, refunds, unsubscribe, catalog publishing and account lifecycle.

requirements.title: Production signup, email verification, recovery and customer identity
Live payment provider, signed webhooks, reconciliation and refunds
requirements.evidence: Checkout through owners' Stripe/Razorpay (15-minute stock holds, provider-confirmed payment, signed webhooks for orders, requests and app records), full and partial refunds with idempotency keys: integration-tested against fake provider APIs. Live provider accounts and reconciliation not yet verified.

requirements.title: Shipping carrier and tax provider integration for supported markets
Production email delivery and deliverability management
requirements.evidence: Order, refund and return emails are sent through SES when MAIL_FROM is set (claimed once, retried up to five times), integration-tested against a stand-in SES endpoint. No live SES delivery or bounce/complaint handling yet.

requirements.title: Tenant usage billing, payment collection and cost monitoring
Backup restore, alerting, retention and account deletion
requirements.evidence: Verified a 464-file local snapshot, restored it to an isolated DynamoDB instance and compared 28 store records successfully. Local account/site deletion and session revocation pass integration tests. Hosted monitoring, retention and offsite recovery remain outstanding.

requirements.title: External sales channels, POS and extension delivery
AWS staging, IAM isolation, public domains and HTTPS verification
